text:
tess: FYI nightly SAST run showed a spike — ~150 new findings on service-api, several look like false positives but a few are missing auth checks. Attachments absent for some PRs.
dan: did anything touch infra around 00:00 UTC? we had a small RBAC tidy last night.
maria: that was me, I removed a few project-level bindings to tighten perms. I left a note but didn't expect scanner fallout.
scan-bot: nightly-scan v3.2.1 finished. Total findings: 150 (+120). High: 8. Missing attachments on PRs: [4521,4523,4529]. Evidence upload errors: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED x3.
alex: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED would cause artifacts to be dropped. Scanner uploads encrypted evidence to GCS, then KMS decrypts during upload verification. If decrypt fails we lose attachments and heuristics reflag the source.
samir: can someone paste a log snippet for the decrypt failure?
tess: log from runner:
```
2026-03-22T02:11:09Z ERROR upload_worker: failed to decrypt artifact: rpc error: code=PermissionDenied desc="cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt permission denied"
scanner: upload aborted; evidence omitted
```
maria: that aligns with the RBAC change — I removed roles including roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter at project level for scanner-sa.
dan: OK, root cause likely the removed KMS permission. Two decisions: restore quickly to resume uploads, and improve alerting so PermissionDenied doesn't slip by.
alex: short-term restore should be scoped to the crypto key rather than project-wide. Example TF binding to use: 
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "scanner_decrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/scanner/cryptoKeys/scanner-key"
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:scanner-sa@myproj.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
samir: on alerting: KMS permission denies are logged as DataAccess entries with protoPayload.status.code=7. Our scan-observability only tracks KeyAccessCount drops; it doesn't surface DataAccess status codes.
tess: we should add a parser to scan-observability to map KMS DataAccess permission denied events to evidence-upload errors and capture principal/resource details.
maria: I'll open a revert PR to reapply the binding scoped to the key. Expect a PR link shortly.
dan: please include a follow-up note to tighten the binding (alex's snippet) and create an incident to track the retro.
scan-bot: created ISSUE-7682 "SAST evidence uploads failing due to KMS permission removal" assigned to eng-security oncall.
alex: mitigation checklist proposal:
- restore key-scoped binding (immediate)
- re-run affected nightly scans and confirm evidence reupload
- add KMS DataAccess -> scan-alert mapping
- add infra preflight check for scanner SA KMS decrypt in PRs
- update RBAC change playbook to list scanners/CI/artefact pipelines as impacted services
samir: for the preflight GH action we can use impersonation to validate decrypt rights:
```
gcloud kms keys decrypt --location=global --keyring=scanner --key=scanner-key \
  --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --plaintext-file=/tmp/pt \
  --impersonate-service-account=scanner-sa@myproj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Fail the check if this command returns non-zero. We'll add a mock path for CI.
tess: maria — can you post the revert PR link? I'll approve to speed this up.
maria: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/ae3f1b7 — re-adds scanner KMS binding scoped to the key. Added TF snippet in description.
dan: looks good, lgtm. tagging infra-approvers.
maria: merged at 03:14 UTC and applied via Terraform Cloud. I've kicked a rerun of the nightly scans.
scan-bot: manual run nightly-2026-03-22-patch-1 triggered by tess. Evidence upload success increased.
tess: re-run diff shows findings returned to baseline. Good recovery.
alex: I'll open a PR to add KMS DataAccess parsing into scan-observability and a Grafana panel for KMS permission denies by principal. Link to follow.
samir: I'll own the GH Action preflight impersonation check and add unit + integration tests. PR expected by EOD.
dan: drafting a blameless postmortem in ISSUE-7682 with timeline, impact, root cause, and action items.
tess: assign clear owners and due dates in the ticket: maria (infra revert owner), alex (observability), samir (preflight), dan (postmortem). Due: 2026-03-29.
maria: noted, sorry all — I underestimated scanner dependencies when tightening project-scoped roles. Will be more cautious.
alex: thanks for the quick fix. Suggest adding a single-line RBAC change checklist item: "Run scanner preflight and KMS decrypt impersonation for scanner-sa".
scan-bot: reaction :thumbsup: from 6 users.
